The water

Incline takes its name from the steep slopes above its source. Snowmelt seeps through granite and alpine meadow at about 2,500 metres and surfaces as a spring from a high cleft in the rock. We keep just enough of what the rock gives it for a smooth, balanced mouthfeel, and bottle it in clear glass so you can see exactly what you are pouring.

At the plant it passes through sand and activated carbon, micron filters and a reverse-osmosis membrane, has its minerals balanced to this water’s profile, and is disinfected with ozone and ultraviolet light before it is filled in a clean room. The batch report is available on request.

Read the Source · See the line

Serving

Serve cool, at 8 to 12 °C, straight from the bottle at the table. Keep it out of direct sunlight.

Delivery and care

Delivered across India, usually within one to two weeks. We call to confirm every order, and any delivery charge, before it is dispatched. If anything arrives damaged, write to hello@onyxaura.in with your order number and a photograph, and we will put it right.
